about: Which skill a write needs before it lands. The skill gate hook blocks the write until the chat has loaded that skill once (Skill tool, a typed /skill, or reading its SKILL.md). Add a route here instead of naming the skill in a prompt. Bypass one run with DISABLE_SKILL_GATE=1.

routes.why: logos, app icons, favicons and brand marks
any interface: pages, screens, components, styles
motion, gestures, springs, sheets and drag
